notes: FIXTURE example of a PERIODIC (torus) population: 64 x 64 cells of 0.25 m = 16 m x 16 m, periodic in x AND y, with canopy exclusion ('disallowed') by shortest wrapped centre distance across the seams. Centres are drawn over the FULL domain (no inset / border): a canopy near an edge wraps and stays ONE plant with ONE id. Use it with the existing species catalog, e.g. python -m leaf generate --species examples/phase0/species.json --config examples/periodic/generation.json --surface-constant 0 --out /tmp/periodic_plants.csv --report /tmp/periodic_report.json (the species traits are NOT duplicated here). The 'periodic' key is [x, y] real booleans; omit it (default [false, false]) for the legacy finite closed domain. Covers and diameters are illustrative fixtures, not calibrations.
